clips.title: The story
paras: Shadowbreak Ravine is a secluded mountain hollow tucked away in southeastern Desolace. Cloaked among jagged crags near Magram Village, this eerie ravine serves as a hidden redoubt for the demonic forces and mortal zealots of the Burning Blade.

Tucked deep into the barren mountain ridges southeast of Magram Village, Shadowbreak Ravine provides the Burning Blade with a secluded staging ground away from the eyes of wandering centaur tribes. Amid strange, oversized mushrooms and grim ritual encampments, cultists labor alongside summoned demons. Here, dark practitioners invoke fel energies and tend heavy ritual chains, using the natural isolation of the ravine to marshal reinforcements and maintain a firm demonic foothold within the badlands of Desolace.
